<noinclude>
Explanatory note under the venue table of a topic page.
</noinclude><includeonly><small>Venues (journals, conference proceedings, book series) where the topic's works
were published in {{{years}}}, as classified by [https://openalex.org OpenAlex] (CC0); repositories
such as arXiv are left out. Share = the venue's part of the topic's {{formatnum:{{{total}}}}} works in
these venues. A venue is listed if it reaches at least {{{min_share}}} % (at most {{{max}}} venues).
Rankings: '''Norway''' = level for 2026 in the Norwegian Register for Scientific Journals, Series and
Publishers ([https://kanalregister.hkdir.no HK-dir], CC BY 4.0): 2 = leading, 1 = scientific,
0 = not approved as scientific. '''CORE''' = conference rank (A*, A, B, C) in the
[https://portal.core.edu.au/conf-ranks/ ICORE/CORE Conference Portal], ICORE 2026 edition; linked to OpenAlex by name and acronym, see [[Conference rankings]].
The number in bold is a combined level on our 0–3 scale, used for sorting: the higher of the Norwegian
level and the CORE rank converted as A* = 3, A = 2, B = 1, C = 0, minus (5 − the weight of conference
proceedings in the field's [[DFG publication type survey (2018)|DFG profile]]){{#if:{{{dfg|}}}|&#32;(here {{{dfg}}}, so
{{#switch:{{{dfg}}}|5=A* = 3, A = 2, B = 1, C = 0|4=A* = 2, A = 1, B and C = 0|3=A* = 1, others = 0|#default=CORE ranks add nothing}})}}.
This is a provisional heuristic for experts to revise.
– = not listed or not matched.
The list shows where the field publishes, not how good a venue is; the levels to be used for
evaluation are proposed and reviewed separately.</small></includeonly>
